verse.text: For the LORD corrects those he loves, just as a father corrects a child in whom he delights.

video.title: I Trust Father, Son, and Holy Spirit! - Charles Spurgeon Devotional

reflection: Correction isn't the opposite of love — it's proof of it. When you take the time to guide your kid back on track, even when it's uncomfortable for both of you, you're mirroring the way God patiently corrects and shapes us. A dad who never says 'that's not okay' isn't being kind, he's checking out; real love stays close enough to notice and speak up.
